payload.reason: The new error categories were designed to improve granularity and practicality in error classification for GEC systems, addressing limitations of previous tagsets.

claims.text: The new error categories allow for detailed error type evaluation at different levels of granularity, which was not possible with previous tagsets.
The design of the new error categories aims to balance informativeness and practicality, avoiding overly complex distinctions that could arise from previous tagsets.
